steps.title: Install ImageMagick 7
steps.detail: Required. Run the Windows x64 installer and keep "Add application directory to your system path" checked, then restart Unify so it sees the new PATH. Ask an agent to run imaging_tools_status to confirm.

steps.title: Add pngquant and oxipng (optional)
steps.detail: For smaller PNGs. Put both .exe files in a folder on your PATH.

steps.title: Add rembg for background removal (optional)
steps.detail: Run this in a terminal, then run rembg once so it downloads its model.

steps.title: Add Real-ESRGAN for upscaling (optional)
steps.detail: Unzip realesrgan-ncnn-vulkan from the releases page and set the DSH_REALESRGAN_PATH environment variable to its .exe.
